name: io.github.bitterdev/pixelletter-mcp
description: Send physical letters and faxes through the PixelLetter interface, test mode included.

environmentVariables.name: PIXELLETTER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: E-mail address the PixelLetter account is registered with

environmentVariables.name: PIXELLETTER_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
environmentVariables.description: Default destination country as a two letter ISO code, for example DE

environmentVariables.name: PIXELLETTER_FORCE_TEST_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Force test mode for every order, so nothing is printed, sent or charged
